Name: Spongebob Valley
Author: Ninj4Kitty
Description:
Hello everyone!

If you ever had to pick between watching SpongeBob or playing Stardew Valley in your free time, give this mod a try so you can do both at the same time.
This mod replaces almost every NPC with a character from Spongebob!

Its still in progress, I will be improving the mod whenever I get the chance, so I would be very happy to hear your feedback.

Have fun!
